text:
[BEDWARS]
[+] Added PromptAura to World: activates nearby prompts with shop and repeat toggles
[+] PromptEditor now has a Set/Expand mode dropdown
[+] AutoConsume discovers every BedWars consumable and supports mushrooms/SingleMushroom
[^] Rewrote CheatDetector with reach, hitbox, aim, killaura cadence, speed, fly, teleport, auto-clicker and AntiDeath void-abuse checks plus a self-test toggle
[!] Fixed Killaura Animation Speed so it scales the whole swing
[!] Fixed SilentAim snapping by suspending camera-turning projectile aids
[!] Fixed StreamRemover and ACMODView Remove Disguises so the real player level shows instead of [?]
[!] Fixed DeathSpawn not teleporting back to the last grounded spot
[^] ESP settings are now collapsible sections instead of one long list
[^] AutoGG delay slider now sits directly under its toggle
[^] Merged the Exploits category into Blatant
[-] Removed InfiniteFly

[GENERAL]
[+] Configs can never be lost: atomic saves, rotating backups and automatic recovery
[^] Config reviewer can edit metadata and config JSON, delete submissions, ban submitters and publish directly
[^] Review queue is gated only by the maintainer key and asks for it when missing
[-] Removed Cloud Configs entirely
[^] Much faster startup: the BedWars pack and five modules are no longer re-downloaded every launch
[^] Replaced the search bar with the compact reference layout
